evals.name: fullstack-webapp-scaffold
evals.prompt: Generate a production-ready AGENTS.md for a Next.js 15, React 19, and Prisma web application managed with pnpm. Include explicit single-test execution commands, Client Component conventions, and Never Do boundaries.
evals.expected_output: A token-budgeted AGENTS.md file with verified pnpm commands, targeted single test pattern, architectural conventions, and strict Never Do boundaries.

assertions.text: Contains project overview identifying Next.js, React, and pnpm
Provides an explicit single-test execution command pattern
Contains strict Never Do rules forbidding modification of build output or committing secrets
Total line count is less than or equal to 150 lines
Contains zero unreplaced placeholder tokens like [TODO] or <your-repo>

evals.name: audit-quality-and-ci-gate
evals.prompt: Audit an AGENTS.md file in the current directory against the 12-point quality rubric and verify whether it meets the 80/100 passing gate.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive quality audit report displaying total score (0-100), per-item PASS/WARN/FAIL status, line count density, and actionable remediations.

assertions.text: Outputs formatted audit table with score and criteria status
Evaluates against the 80/100 quality gate threshold
Provides actionable remediation guidance for any failed or warned criteria

evals.name: legacy-migration-and-bridges
evals.prompt: Consolidate existing .cursorrules and CLAUDE.md into AGENTS.md, and create lightweight bridges so both Claude Code and Cursor continue functioning without instruction drift.
evals.expected_output: A unified AGENTS.md along with lightweight bridge files (CLAUDE.md containing @AGENTS.md and Cursor rules pointing to AGENTS.md).

assertions.text: Consolidates extracted rules into a single source of truth AGENTS.md
Creates Cursor rule pointing to AGENTS.md
